items.definition:
relating to Vienna or its people
She enjoyed a traditional Viennese coffee.

innocent of wrongdoing
She was entirely blameless in the accident.

able to be transmitted from one person to another
Influenza is a highly communicable disease.

conducive to health
Eating fresh fruits and vegetables is healthful.

requiring much effort and time
The task of cleaning the entire house was laborious.

clear enough to read
Please write clearly so your notes are legible.

suitable or good enough to live in or with
They were looking for a small but livable apartment.

acceptable; adequate
The food was passable, but nothing special.

likely to decay quickly
Fresh produce is highly perishable and needs to be refrigerated.

small and weak
The puny kitten struggled to climb the stairs.

smelling or tasting unpleasant from being old and stale
The butter had turned rancid.

able to be recovered
The data was recoverable after the system crash.

able to be found or followed
The origin of the infection was traceable to a single source.

crazy; eccentric
Her ideas sometimes seem a bit batty, but they're often brilliant.

tiny; very small
She found a bitty piece of chocolate under the couch.

unable to be heard
His whisper was almost inaudible.

diligent and hardworking
She is an industrious student who always completes her assignments on time.

newsworthy (sufficiently interesting to be reported in a newspaper or news broadcast)
The discovery of the ancient artifact was considered highly newsworthy.

having the form of a parabola
The satellite dish has a parabolic shape to focus signals.

ostentatious, attracting attention
The peacock displayed its showy feathers.

behaving, done, or made in a cautious and surreptitious manner, so as not to be seen or heard
The cat made a stealthy approach towards the bird.

not changed or modified
The ancient ruins remained largely unaltered over the centuries.

not officially designated as secret
This document is unclassified and can be shared publicly.

not good or helpful
The weather conditions were unfavorable for the outdoor event.

not loved or cared for
The old toy looked unloved, sitting forgotten in the corner.

having had one's true character or identity revealed
The villain's true identity was finally unmasked at the end of the story.

unpleasant to look at
The abandoned building was an unsightly blot on the landscape.

unable to be penetrated by water
The boat had a watertight compartment for valuables.

on the side facing the wind
The ship sailed on the windward side of the island.

large or important enough to be noticed or measured
There was an appreciable difference in temperature.

Resistant to fire.
The building materials were designed to be fireproof.

Resembling glass in smoothness, transparency, or luster.
The lake was perfectly still, with a glassy surface.

dirty; unkempt
His hands were grubby after working in the garden.

uncertain; doubtful; risky
The weather forecast looks a bit iffy for tomorrow's picnic.

unable to be moved
The ancient stone statue seemed completely immovable.

feeling or characterized by great anger
The irate customer demanded to speak to the manager immediately.

sluggish and apathetic
After the long flight, I felt lethargic and just wanted to sleep.

mad or silly
He came up with a loony idea for a new invention.

relating to the Middle Ages
They visited a medieval castle in France.

(in sports) in an allowed position; (general) in agreement or supportive.
The referee ruled that the player was onside.

full of stones, rocky
The stony path was difficult to walk on.

relating to a telescope; able to extend and retract
The camera has a powerful telescopic lens.

not yet diagnosed
Many people live with undiagnosed medical conditions.

not interested or involved in politics
He prefers to remain apolitical and focus on his work.

relating to astrology
She reads her astrological forecast every morning.

relating to Bali or its people
We enjoyed the traditional Balinese dance performance.

(of a person or thing) worn out or ruined because of age or neglect
The old house was decrepit and falling apart.

behaving in a way that shows a playful sexual attraction
Her flirtatious smile made him blush.

difficult, dangerous, or challenging (slang)
That was a gnarly wave to surf!

lacking any obvious principle of organization
His notes were haphazard and difficult to follow.

able to be understood
Her speech was barely intelligible after the accident.

critical; quick to judge
Try not to be too judgmental of others.

Unconventional; unusual.
She has a very offbeat sense of humor.

allowing great freedom of behavior
The school has a very permissive attitude towards dress code.

relating to education after high school
Many students pursue postsecondary education after graduation.

able to be saved or exchanged for something else
This coupon is redeemable for a free coffee.

evasive or deceitful
His shifty eyes made me distrust him immediately.

of an orange-brown or yellowish-brown color
The lion had a beautiful tawny mane.

very loud, like thunder
The crowd gave a thunderous applause after the performance.

not edited or revised
The director released an unedited version of the film.

not chosen by election
The committee consists of both elected and unelected members.

relating to autumn
The trees displayed beautiful autumnal colors.

covered with dirt or soot; dirty
His hands were grimy after working on the car engine.

Extremely active
The child was hyperactive after eating too much sugar.
